## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Approved scope and acceptance criteria are linked.
- [ ] The change is limited to the approved task.
- [ ] Public API, data, and compatibility impact is documented.

## Verification

<!-- List exact commands and results. -->

- [ ] Formatting and linting pass.
- [ ] Type checking or Java compilation passes.
- [ ] Unit tests pass.
- [ ] Applicable integration, contract, component, and end-to-end tests pass.
- [ ] Overall coverage is at least 80%.
- [ ] New-code coverage is at least 90%.
- [ ] Sonar has no new blocker/critical finding and duplication is at most 3%.
- [ ] Production builds pass.

## Security, privacy, and authorization

- [ ] Authentication, permissions, organization ownership, and object
      relationships are tested where applicable.
- [ ] Inputs and uploaded content are validated at trust boundaries.
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, signed URLs, protected content, or production data
      appear in code, logs, tests, screenshots, or artifacts.
- [ ] Secret, dependency, static, container, and infrastructure scans pass as
      applicable.

## Operational impact

- [ ] Audit and observability changes are included.
- [ ] Accessibility impact is tested.
- [ ] Database/infrastructure migrations are documented and rehearsed.
- [ ] Performance and cost impact is understood.
- [ ] Deployment, rollback, or forward-fix steps are documented.
- [ ] Runbooks and support documentation are updated.
